marya: Observing a perf regression on mi250 int8 after yesterday's autotuner deploy — ~8% p95 increase at seqlen 1024. Traces show we fell back to the generic kernel for a bunch of requests.

simon: Can you paste the perf summary and which commit was rolled?

marya: Perf summary: token/sec down ~6%, p95 up ~8% on production traces for long-context chat. Commit rolled was 7c9b3a (autotuner signature-matching change). Repro + profile commands below.
```bash
# repro
./bin/run_infer --model llama-int8 --device mi250 --batch 1 --seqlen 1024 --quant int8
# profile kernels
./bin/profile --kernels --out perf.json
```

dev-bot: deploy-bot: promoted 7c9b3a to canary on prod at 2025-08-31T14:02:11Z

kai: Quick scan of perf.json: kernel registry lookup returned NO_MATCH for signature `mi250:int8:tile16x64` so runtime selected `generic_tiled` path. Registry excerpt: `mi250:int8:tile32x32 -> optimized`, `mi250:int8:tile16x64 -> MISSING`.

simon: Right — the autotuner change now buckets by seq_len ranges and returns the "closest" kernel family, not the exact tile signature. Looks like we dropped the precise tile for seqlen=1024.

julia: I repro'd locally. When we hit generic_tiled, KV cache hit ratio drops ~15% because the generic path writes KV in a different layout, triggering a hot-path transpose and memcpy. That explains the tail increase.

marya: Wait — KV layout mismatch? Does fallback reserialize KV or just transpose on the fly?

kai: It doesn't reserialize serialized KV blobs; the tiled kernel expects KV shape [heads, head_dim, seq] while generic uses [seq, heads, head_dim]. Fallback triggers an on-the-fly transpose which adds ~0.6ms per token for long contexts.

simon: Two immediate actions proposed: (1) soft-route rule to prefer compatible tiled kernels for seqlen >= 512 even if registry lacks exact signature, (2) add an autotuner telemetry metric for kernel-matching failures so we can alert on these regressions.

julia: For (1) we can add a policy: if NO_MATCH and driver reports support for kernel family `mi250:int8:tiling-v2`, route to nearest tile and set `expect_kv_layout=legacy` to avoid transpose. Risk: needs correctness test coverage for kv layout.

ops-bot: ci/presubmit: kernel-regression-tests failed on macstadium/mi250-int8 at job 4421 — see https://ci.local/4421 

marya: I'm going to try a hotfix: set ENV FORCE_LEGACY_KERNEL=true for the canary cluster and retest. Will tag telemetry. Any objections?

kai: go for it. Add telemetry tag `forced_legacy_kernel` and `autotune_match_reason` so we can segment.

marya: Patch pushed as 8a2f11, canary env updated. Re-running the same trace locally — p95 is back to baseline, token/sec matches pre-deploy. Will monitor prod.

simon: Long-term: autotuner should prefer kernel family stability over microbench winsthat introduce KV-layout churn. Also add an offline job to prepopulate registry for common seqlen buckets (512, 1024, 2048) for each device/quant combo. Filed INF-1123: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1123

marya: :thumbsup: I'll add a unit/integ test that validates KV layout compatibility on kernel registration and gate the autotuner change behind a feature flag until we have telemetry coverage.
